changes.name: SkyboundPetManager
changes.source:
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local equip=RS:WaitForChild("SkyboundEquipPet")
local rarity={["Cloud Bunny"]="Common",["Sky Fox"]="Uncommon",["Sun Cub"]="Epic",["Storm Dragon"]="Legendary",["Bubble Bunny"]="Common",["River Fox"]="Uncommon",["Aqua Cub"]="Epic",["Tide Dragon"]="Legendary",["Sand Bunny"]="Common",["Dune Fox"]="Uncommon",["Sun Lion"]="Epic",["Pharaoh Dragon"]="Legendary"}
local power={Common=1,Uncommon=2,Rare=3,Epic=5,Legendary=8,Mythic=12,Secret=20}
local function clear(p)
 for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do if o:GetAttribute("PetOwner")==p.UserId then o:Destroy() end end
 local root=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if root then for _,a in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do if a.Name:match("^SkyPetPoint") then a:Destroy() end end end
end
local function modelPet(p,name,index)
 local root=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not root then return end
 local r=rarity[name] or "Rare";local colors={Common=Color3.fromRGB(235,245,255),Uncommon=Color3.fromRGB(90,220,150),Rare=Color3.fromRGB(80,170,255),Epic=Color3.fromRGB(190,90,255),Legendary=Color3.fromRGB(255,190,50),Mythic=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,150),Secret=Color3.fromRGB(70,70,90)}
 local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name=p.Name.."_"..name;m:SetAttribute("PetOwner",p.UserId);m.Parent=workspace
 local body=Instance.new("Part");body.Name="Body";body.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;body.Size=Vector3.new(3.5,3,3.5);body.Color=colors[r];body.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;body.CanCollide=false;body.Massless=true;body.Parent=m
 local head=Instance.new("Part");head.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;head.Size=Vector3.new(2.5,2.5,2.5);head.Color=colors[r];head.CanCollide=false;head.Massless=true;head.CFrame=body.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.8,-1);head.Parent=m
 local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=body;w.Part1=head;w.Parent=body
 local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui");gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(170,45);gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0);gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.Parent=head
 local t=Instance.new("TextLabel");t.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);t.BackgroundTransparency=1;t.Text=name.." ["..r.."]";t.TextScaled=true;t.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);t.TextStrokeTransparency=.2;t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;t.Parent=gui
 body.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4+(index-1)*2,1,3)
 local a=Instance.new("Attachment");a.Name="SkyPetPoint"..index;a.Position=Vector3.new(4+(index-1)*3,1,3);a.Parent=root
 local b=Instance.new("Attachment");b.Parent=body
 local ap=Instance.new("AlignPosition");ap.Attachment0=b;ap.Attachment1=a;ap.MaxForce=60000;ap.Responsiveness=10;ap.Parent=body
end
local function refresh(p)
 clear(p);local folder=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets");if not folder then return end
 local total=0;local i=0
 for _,v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do i+=1;local r=rarity[v.Value] or "Rare";total+=power[r] or 1;modelPet(p,v.Value,i) end
 p:SetAttribute("PetPower",total)
end
equip.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,name)
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then return end
 local owned=false;for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do if v.Value==name then owned=true break end end;if not owned then return end
 local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets") or Instance.new("Folder");eq.Name="EquippedPets";eq.Parent=p
 for _,v in ipairs(eq:GetChildren()) do if v.Value==name then v:Destroy();refresh(p);return end end
 if #eq:GetChildren()>=3 then return end
 local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name="Pet"..(#eq:GetChildren()+1);v.Value=name;v.Parent=eq;refresh(p)
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) local e=Instance.new("Folder");e.Name="EquippedPets";e.Parent=p end)

changes.name: SkyboundPetInventory
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players");local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="PetInventoryUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(130,46);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,18,1,-70);b.Text="PETS";b.TextScaled=true;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.Parent=gui
local frame=Instance.new("Frame");frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(430,420);frame.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-215,.5,-210);frame.Visible=false;frame.Parent=gui
local title=Instance.new("TextLabel");title.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,55);title.BackgroundTransparency=1;title.Text="SKYBOUND PETS  •  EQUIP 3";title.TextScaled=true;title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;title.Parent=frame
local list=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame");list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15,65);list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30,1,-80);list.CanvasSize=UDim2.new();list.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;list.Parent=frame
local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout");layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,7);layout.Parent=list
local function rebuild()
 for _,x in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("TextButton") then x:Destroy() end end
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then return end
 for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do local x=Instance.new("TextButton");x.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,52);x.Text=v.Value.."   •   CLICK TO EQUIP / UNEQUIP";x.TextScaled=true;x.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;x.Parent=list;x.Activated:Connect(function() RS.SkyboundEquipPet:FireServer(v.Value) end) end
end
b.Activated:Connect(function() frame.Visible=not frame.Visible;if frame.Visible then rebuild() end end)
task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(2);if frame.Visible then rebuild() end end end)

changes.name: EggHatchEffects
changes.source:
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
for _,d in ipairs(workspace.SkyboundMap:GetDescendants()) do
 if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Name=="HatchPrompt" then
  d.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
   local egg=d.Parent;if not egg:IsA("BasePart") then return end
   local original=egg.Size
   TweenService:Create(egg,TweenInfo.new(.15,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Size=original*1.18}):Play()
   task.delay(.18,function() if egg.Parent then TweenService:Create(egg,TweenInfo.new(.2),{Size=original}):Play() end end)
  end)
 end
end

changes.name: SkyboundDataSaveV2
changes.source:
local DSS=game:GetService("DataStoreService");local Players=game:GetService("Players");local store=DSS:GetDataStore("SkyboundPlayerData_v2")
local attrs={"WaterfallUnlocked","DesertUnlocked","FrozenUnlocked","VolcanoRealmUnlocked","CelestialCityUnlocked","VoidRealmUnlocked"}
local function save(p)
 local c=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not c then return end
 local d={coins=c.Value,pets={},equipped={},unlocks={}}
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if inv then for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do table.insert(d.pets,v.Value) end end
 local eq=p:FindFirstChild("EquippedPets");if eq then for _,v in ipairs(eq:GetChildren()) do table.insert(d.equipped,v.Value) end end
 for _,a in ipairs(attrs) do d.unlocks[a]=p:GetAttribute(a)==true end
 pcall(function() store:SetAsync("P_"..p.UserId,d) end)
end
local function load(p)
 local ok,d=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("P_"..p.UserId) end);if not ok or type(d)~="table" then return end
 local c=p:WaitForChild("leaderstats",10) and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if c then c.Value=d.coins or 0 end
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets") or Instance.new("Folder");inv.Name="Pets";inv.Parent=p
 for _,n in ipairs(d.pets or {}) do local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name=n;v.Value=n;v.Parent=inv end
 local eq=p:WaitForChild("EquippedPets",10);if eq then for i,n in ipairs(d.equipped or {}) do if i<=3 then local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name="Pet"..i;v.Value=n;v.Parent=eq end end end
 for _,a in ipairs(attrs) do p:SetAttribute(a,d.unlocks and d.unlocks[a]==true) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.delay(2,load,p) end);Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)
task.spawn(function() while task.wait(60) do for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save,p) end end end)
game:BindToClose(function() for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save,p) end task.wait(3) end)
